benchmarks.title: EnterpriseRAG Notes
benchmarks.about: EnterpriseRAG-Bench (Onyx, 2026) cut to what people keep in Context: a made-up company's docs, wiki, meetings, tickets, pull requests and customer records filed as notes (its Slack and email left out, as Context saves neither), and the 343 questions whose answers are in them.

source.name: EnterpriseRAG-Bench (Onyx, arXiv 2605.05253), adapted: Slack and Gmail documents and every question citing them left out
source.data: onyx-dot-app/EnterpriseRAG-Bench on Hugging Face, fetched at run time at a pinned revision; never kept in this repository
source.license: MIT, Copyright (c) Onyx (as the dataset card states); scores are ours and not comparable with its leaderboard

benchmarks.title: HERB
benchmarks.about: Salesforce's public benchmark of messy workplace data: 30 made-up products' Slack, meetings, docs, links and pull requests in one pool, 815 questions citing the artifacts that answer them.

source.name: HERB (Choubey et al., Salesforce AI Research, EMNLP 2025 industry track, arXiv 2506.23139)
source.data: Salesforce/HERB on Hugging Face, fetched at run time at the revision the Hub names; never kept in this repository
source.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial: we score with it and publish only our numbers)

benchmarks.title: LongMemEval
benchmarks.about: 500 questions, each after a long history of past chats: Context as an AI client's memory. A memory run saves and files every past session, then a fresh reader answers and LongMemEval's own judge grades it; the retrieval run only asks whether search finds the answer sessions.

source.name: LongMemEval (Wu et al., ICLR 2025)
source.data: xiaowu0162/longmemeval-cleaned on Hugging Face, fetched at run time

benchmarks.title: NanoBEIR
benchmarks.about: The standard public retrieval benchmark: BEIR's 13 sets cut to 50 queries each, scored by nDCG@10 beside BM25's own ranking.

source.name: NanoBEIR (Zeta Alpha, 2024), cut from BEIR (Thakur et al., NeurIPS 2021)
source.data: sentence-transformers/Nano<Set>-bm25 on Hugging Face, fetched at run time at the revision the Hub names
source.license: each set keeps its BEIR source's license

benchmarks.title: Search
benchmarks.about: Made-up questions as Priya, who reaches seven workspaces, written so the easy word match is the wrong note: notes that quote the question, other workspaces using the same words, long notes, archives, paraphrases.

source.name: Context's own, written for the Search suite (2026-11-21)

benchmarks.title: Search
benchmarks.about: Real searches that failed (nothing opened, or searched again), rewritten never verbatim, each with the notes that make it hard. Split 60/20/20: Training and Dev here, Test sealed in the eval service and the search gate's.

source.name: Context's own, from the search quality log, rewritten

runs.title: EnterpriseRAG Notes
runs.about: EnterpriseRAG-Bench without Slack or email: 343 questions over 10,000 of its notes (every cited one, the rest the closest-titled of the same kind), scored by nDCG@10 per question type. Embeddings only.

runs.title: EnterpriseRAG Notes
runs.about: The same 343 questions and 10,000 notes, split the way a person reaches them: their own workspace (meetings) and three shared ones (engineering, wiki and docs, sales). Each search asks all four, so it measures ranking across workspaces. Embeddings only.

runs.title: EnterpriseRAG Notes
runs.about: The same 343 questions over every one of its 104,967 docs, wiki pages, meetings, tickets, pull requests and customer records. Hours, and a few dollars of embeddings.

runs.title: HERB
runs.about: Salesforce's public benchmark of messy workplace data: 30 products' Slack, meetings, docs, links and pull requests in one pool (39,772 artifacts), 815 questions, scored by nDCG@10 per question type. Embeddings only.

runs.title: LongMemEval
runs.about: 500 questions, each after about 50 past chat sessions (about 115k tokens).

runs.title: LongMemEval
runs.about: The same 500 questions with only the sessions that hold the evidence.

runs.title: LongMemEval
runs.about: LongMemEval's past sessions saved as notes: are the answer sessions in search's top 5? No reader, no judge. Embeddings only.

runs.title: NanoBEIR
runs.about: The standard public retrieval benchmark (BEIR's 13 sets cut to 50 queries each), scored by nDCG@10 beside BM25's own ranking. Embeddings only.

runs.title: NanoBEIR
runs.about: NanoBEIR's MS MARCO, NQ, FiQA and SciFact: the four the search gate runs on every search change. Embeddings only.

runs.title: Search
runs.about: Made-up questions in a world of seven workspaces, with notes that quote the question, long notes and archives. Embeddings only.
